row.team_price_text: Core: $29/mo per store billed annually (flat, not per user)
row.evidence: BigCommerce's pricing page and developer docs list no SCIM or control-panel SSO; control panel users are created under Account Settings › Users or through the GraphQL Account API, which "lets you create, edit, and delete BigCommerce control panel users."
row.notes: New row. No SCIM endpoint or customer-IdP SAML/OIDC SSO for control panel users is documented on the pricing page, the developer docs sitemap, the API reference or the help-centre pages checked, so status is none by absence. Plans are flat per store and GMV-capped (Core $29, Growth $79, Scale $299 per month billed annually; Performance custom from $1,499/mo), so per-user prices are null. Control-panel users can be automated through the GraphQL Account API (account-level API account created by the store owner; add/remove users to accounts and stores), described as mainly for Enterprise merchants integrating third-party user management; group-based Team permissions is in closed beta. The docs give two different /accounts rate limits (2,000/hour vs 70/hour). The Okta OIN BigCommerce app (2015) is SWA only. Customer Login (SSO) API is for storefront shoppers, not staff.
